query_evidence.question: ORACLE B1 for scenarios Q05
query_evidence.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT s.session_id, s.session_started_at, s.last_activity_at, s.platform, s.country_at_event,
       COALESCE(s.user_id,
                (SELECT MIN(l.user_id) FROM identity_links l
                 WHERE l.session_id = s.session_id
                 GROUP BY l.session_id
                 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_id) = 1)) AS resolved_user_id
FROM sessions s), m(month, ms, me) AS (VALUES ('2026-04','2026-04-01T00:00:00Z','2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-05','2026-05-01T00:00:00Z','2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-06','2026-06-01T00:00:00Z','2026-07-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-07','2026-07-01T00:00:00Z','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-08','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-09','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z','2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')), a AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.month, r.resolved_user_id AS uid, r.platform FROM m JOIN r ON r.session_started_at < m.me AND r.last_activity_at >= m.ms WHERE r.resolved_user_id IS NOT NULL), per AS (SELECT month, uid, count(DISTINCT platform) np FROM a GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT p.month, count(*) mau, sum(np>=2) multi_platform_users, sum(np) sum_of_platform_counts FROM per p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
